final_response_fingerprint.details: Read-only independent review (no cargo, no source edits, no git writes) of OpenSpec change reconcile-overnight-runs-after-restart. Use `git diff` (ignore src/cli/terminal.rs, which is another session's) and read the new file crates/jcode-app-core/src/overnight/restart.rs. Compare with openspec/changes/reconcile-overnight-runs-after-restart/{proposal.md,specs/**,tasks.md}. FIRST, immediately create scratch/applyall/review-reconcile-overnight.md with a skeleton and append findings every few minutes (server reloads kill workers). Check: (1) CancelRequested can never resume and never reaches the dispatch gate; (2) a live foreign owner is never duplicated, and pid-reuse handling (supervisor_start_time) is sound, including the exec-reload same-pid case; (3) races: two reconcile passes or reconcile racing a user cancel or a resettle (enforce::resettle_in_background), and save_manifest merge semantics in overnight/admission.rs (can a stale save revive a cancelled run, or can the Interrupted save be overwritten?); (4) config can never widen persisted authorization; no worktree creation; wake time never consulted; (5) every failure path fails closed to Interrupted with a reason; (6) heartbeat task lifecycle (abort on drop, no leak after terminal); (7) the visible-start change `resolved_route_auth_block` in admission_gate.rs/overnight.rs does not weaken supervised-run auth blocking; (8) tasks.md boxes are backed by evidence and the known limits are honest. Classify findings blocker/major/minor with file:line. End with `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes-requested` and `REVIEW COMPLETE`.
